title: Blockchain-enabled supply chain finance and operational performance of blockchain enterprise: an empirical study from China
title_primary: Blockchain-enabled supply chain finance and operational performance of blockchain enterprise: an empirical study from China
authors: Jianbai Gu, Malin Song, Xueli Chen, Jiajia Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Based on the empirical study using convex nonparametric least squares (CNLS) with a within estimator for panel data analysis, this research examines the impact of supply chain finance (SCF) on blockchain enterprise operational performance. The methodology mitigates over-parameterization by assigning unique shadow prices to each firm, enhancing interpretability. Results reveal significant industry heterogeneity: SCF substantially improves operational performance in the application software and information technology consulting sectors, where financing constraints are acute. This positive effect is primarily driven by the use of notes payable rather than short-term loans, reflecting the varying accessibility and suitability of different SCF instruments. Conversely, internet software and electronic equipment firms exhibit negligible responsiveness, attributed to alternative financing access (e.g. equity, policy-backed loans) or misaligned SCF instrument terms. The study underscores the context-dependent efficacy of blockchain enterprises SCF, advocating tailored implementation to alleviate SME financing bottlenecks and optimize supply chain resilience. Policy and managerial emphasis should prioritize user-centric blockchain solutions to amplify operational gains. KEYWORDS: Supply chain management blockchain operational research financial management convex nonparametric least squares JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 O33 C23

title: Promoting green governance: government procurement and corporate green governance performance
title_zh: 促进绿色治理：政府采购与企业绿色治理绩效
title_primary: 促进绿色治理：政府采购与企业绿色治理绩效
title_secondary: Promoting green governance: government procurement and corporate green governance performance
authors: Kai Wan, Xiyao Qin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Promoting corporate green governance is essential for sustainable development. Using a panel of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2015 to 2023, this paper examines how government procurement influences corporate green governance performance. The results reveal that receiving government procurement significantly enhances a firm’s green governance performance. Mechanism analyses demonstrate that this effect operates through two channels: stimulating corporate environmental protection investment and promoting green innovation. Heterogeneity analyses further show that the positive effect is more pronounced among firms with stronger environmental awareness, larger size and mature lifecycle stages, as well as those in high polluting industries. These findings highlight the role of government procurement as an effective demand-side instrument in driving corporate green governance. KEYWORDS: Government procurement corporate green governance performance environmental protection investment green innovation JEL CLASSIFICATION: H57 M14 G34

title: Pollution, reproductive health capital, and fertility
title_zh: 污染、生殖健康资本与生育率
title_primary: 污染、生殖健康资本与生育率
title_secondary: Pollution, reproductive health capital, and fertility
authors: Yakita, Akira
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Recent research indicates that human infertility rate is increasing. This study explores the hypothesis that this change has occurred because of increasing pollution, which damages the reproductive health of individuals. Individuals can choose the number of their children without worrying about pollution effects when pollution is small relative to reproductive health capital. Nevertheless, when pollution becomes large in a relative sense, it constrains the number of children that individuals can bear and rear. Reduced childrearing time enables young workers to work longer and to earn more, accelerating physical capital accumulation and consequently boosting economic growth. The accelerated physical capital accumulation in turn increases pollution, thereby lowering the fertility rate further. On a balanced growth path, the fertility rate remains constant over periods, but the fertility rate might be lower than the population replacement rate. Pollution abatement measures raise the fertility rate by reducing pollution damage to reproductive health. Although the long-term growth effect of pollution tax changes is ambiguous, the growth rate after the tax changes is lower than the balanced growth rate without a binding fertility constraint.

title: Assessing Government Subsidies for Reducing Pesticide Use: A Meta‐Analysis
title_zh: 评估政府补贴减少农药使用的效果：一项元分析
title_primary: 评估政府补贴减少农药使用的效果：一项元分析
title_secondary: Assessing Government Subsidies for Reducing Pesticide Use: A Meta‐Analysis
authors: Gaëlle Leduc, Douadia Bougherara, Thi Thanh Mai Ha, Laure Latruffe
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the efforts being made by governments to reduce pesticide use, subsidies are an important instrument to encourage farmers to adopt more sustainable practices. Yet, their effectiveness remains uncertain due to diverse designs and contexts. To date, there are no studies that provide systematic synthesized evidence on the potentially heterogeneous effects of subsidies on pesticide use. The present study addresses this gap by conducting a meta‐analysis of 39 empirical studies (208 models) from the EU and other developed countries that examine the effects of subsidies on (i) direct measurement of pesticide use and (ii) indirect measurement of pesticide use based on the adoption of pesticide‐reducing practices. Using probit meta‐regressions and qualitative appraisal, we find two key results. First, for EU studies, Pillar I and Pillar II subsidies from the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) have opposite effects on pesticide use: Pillar II subsidies are more likely than Pillar I subsidies to reduce pesticide use. Second, if we consider studies from both the EU and the US, subsidies that target adoption of whole‐farm systems or bundles of practices outperform those targeting a single practice in reducing pesticide use. We provide some policy recommendations for policy design and highlight future research priorities.
abstract_zh: 在各国政府减少农药使用的努力中，补贴是鼓励农民采纳更可持续做法的重要工具。然而，由于设计多样和情境差异，其有效性仍不确定。迄今为止，尚无研究提供关于补贴对农药使用可能存在的异质性效应的系统性综合证据。本研究通过荟萃分析39项来自欧盟及其他发达国家的实证研究（共208个模型），填补了这一空白，这些研究考察了补贴对（i）农药使用的直接测量及（ii）基于采纳减农药实践间接测量农药使用的影响。运用概率元回归及定性评估，我们得出两个关键结果。第一，就欧盟研究而言，共同农业政策（CAP）下的第一支柱和第二支柱补贴对农药使用具有相反效应：第二支柱补贴比第一支柱补贴更有可能减少农药使用。第二，若考虑欧盟和美国的研究，针对采纳整个农场系统或实践组合的补贴在减少农药使用方面优于针对单一实践的补贴。我们为政策设计提供了一些建议，并强调了未来研究的优先方向。

title: Bank Opacity and Safe Asset Moneyness
title_zh: 银行不透明度与安全资产货币性
title_primary: 银行不透明度与安全资产货币性
title_secondary: Bank Opacity and Safe Asset Moneyness
authors: SANG RAE KIM
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A bank is more effective as a supplier of money‐like safe assets when (i) its return on equity (ROE) is relatively lower and (ii) it is relatively more opaque about its balance sheet. A model is presented to support this, emphasizing that safe asset investors focus on the left tail of the collateral value distribution. Empirical tests on dealer banks and money market mutual funds' (MMFs') funding relationships confirm that higher ROE leads to MMF withdrawal due to lower moneyness of safe assets. Bank opacity mitigates the strength of this relationship, making it optimal for the banking system to maintain a certain level of opacity.
abstract_zh: 银行在作为货币类安全资产的供应者时，其有效性取决于两个条件：（i）其股本回报率（ROE）相对较低；（ii）其资产负债表相对不透明。本文提出一个模型来支持这一观点，强调安全资产投资者关注的是抵押品价值分布的左尾部分。对交易商银行与货币市场共同基金（MMFs）融资关系的实证检验证实，较高的股本回报率会导致MMFs撤资，原因是安全资产的货币性降低。银行的不透明性削弱了这一关系的强度，使得银行体系维持一定水平的不透明性成为最优选择。

title: Towards a Theory of Platform Dynamics
title_zh: 迈向平台动态理论
title_primary: 迈向平台动态理论
title_secondary: Towards a Theory of Platform Dynamics
authors: Luis Cabral
official: 官方在线 2018-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I introduce a dynamic framework to analyze platforms. The (single) platform owner sets prices at the beginning of each period. Agents (buyers, sellers, readers, consumers, merchants, etc) make platform membership decisions occasionally. I show that optimal platform pricing addresses two externalities: across sides and across time periods. This results in optimal prices which depend on platform size in a non-trivial way. By means of numerical simulations, I examine the determinants of equilibrium platform size, showing that the stationary distribution of platform size may be bi-modal, that is, with some probability the platform remains very low or takes very long to increase in size. I also contrast the dynamics of proprietary vs non-proprietary (i.e., zero-priced) platforms; and consider the specific case of asymmetric platforms (one side cares about the other but not vice-versa).
abstract_zh: 我引入了一个动态框架来分析平台。平台（单一）所有者在每期初设定价格。代理人（买家、卖家、读者、消费者、商家等）偶尔做出平台成员决策。我表明，最优平台定价需解决两种外部性：跨边外部性和跨期外部性。这导致最优价格以非平凡方式依赖于平台规模。通过数值模拟，我考察了均衡平台规模的决定因素，显示平台规模的平稳分布可能是双峰的，即平台以一定概率保持极低水平或需要很长时间才能增长。我还对比了专有平台与非专有（即零价格）平台的动态；并考虑了不对称平台的具体情形（一方关心另一方，但反之不然）。

title: Provider Altruism and Medical Fraud: Evidence from an Audit Study of Malaria Treatment
title_zh: 提供者利他主义与医疗欺诈：来自疟疾治疗审计研究的证据
title_primary: 提供者利他主义与医疗欺诈：来自疟疾治疗审计研究的证据
title_secondary: Provider Altruism and Medical Fraud: Evidence from an Audit Study of Malaria Treatment
authors: Paul Gertler, Ada Kwan
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide evidence of fraudulent diagnostic misreporting leading to spending on unnecessary medical care and show that it is strongly associated with provider profit motivation and weak prosocial preferences. Using incognito standardized patients (SP) presenting identical acute malaria symptoms as real walk-in clients to private providers in Kenya, we observe diagnostic and treatment decisions under controlled conditions with externally verified disease status. Because the SPs were confirmed to be malaria-negative, any reported positive diagnosis is a false positive by construction. Providers ordered malaria tests in 81% of the SP encounters. Conditional on administering a malaria test, providers report false positive results in 30% of encounters, substantially exceeding the approximately 3-5% false positive rates reported for the same malaria tests in diagnostic accuracy studies. This occurs despite near-perfect knowledge of appropriate diagnostic protocols. We link this behavior to provider preferences measured using a real-stakes, modified dictator game. While ordering a test is uncorrelated with preferences, the top 25% most profit-motivated providers report 16 percentage point (pp) more false positives and sell 20 pp more antimalarial drugs than more altruistic providers, conditional on ordering a malaria test. Misreporting is accompanied by selective concealment of diagnostic evidence from patients.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于欺诈性诊断误报导致不必要医疗支出增加的证据，并表明这种行为与提供者的利润动机及较弱的社会偏好密切相关。通过使用隐姓埋名的标准化病人（SP），他们以真实就诊客户的身份向肯尼亚的私人医疗服务提供者呈现相同的急性疟疾症状，我们在外部验证疾病状态的受控条件下观察诊断和治疗决策。由于这些SP被确认为疟疾阴性，任何报告的阳性诊断在构造上即为假阳性。提供者在81%的SP就诊中要求进行疟疾检测。在实施疟疾检测的条件下，提供者在30%的就诊中报告了假阳性结果，这一比例显著超过了同一疟疾检测在诊断准确性研究中报告的约3-5%的假阳性率。尽管提供者对适当诊断方案近乎完全了解，这种情况仍然发生。我们将这一行为与通过真实赌注的改良独裁者游戏测得的提供者偏好联系起来。虽然要求检测与偏好无关，但在要求疟疾检测的条件下，利润动机最强的前25%提供者报告的假阳性率比更利他的提供者高出16个百分点（pp），并多销售20个百分点的抗疟药物。误报行为伴随着对患者选择性隐瞒诊断证据。

title: Geopolitics and space access: cost asymmetries and strategic dependence
title_zh: 地缘政治与太空进入：成本不对称与战略依赖
title_primary: 地缘政治与太空进入：成本不对称与战略依赖
title_secondary: Geopolitics and space access: cost asymmetries and strategic dependence
authors: Alessio Terzi, Francesco Nicoli
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Access to space is now a national security priority, yet its cost varies enormously across nations. Using a novel dataset of over 6,740 rocket launches (1960–2025), we estimate country-level launch costs and country-specific experience curves. In 2025, the average costs per kilogram to Low Earth Orbit ranged from $3,225 in the United States to over $13,000 in India, with Europe, Russia, China, and Japan in between. Since 2010, only the US and Europe display statistically significant experience curves, with the US improving far faster. These widening asymmetries reinforce strategic dependencies with economic and security implications.
abstract_zh: 进入太空现已成为国家安全优先事项，然而各国在此方面的成本差异巨大。利用一项涵盖1960至2025年间超过6740次火箭发射的新数据集，我们估算了国家层面的发射成本及各国特有的经验曲线。2025年，将每公斤载荷送入近地轨道的平均成本，从美国的3225美元到印度的超过13000美元不等，欧洲、俄罗斯、中国和日本则介于两者之间。自2010年以来，仅美国和欧洲展现出统计上显著的经验曲线，其中美国的改进速度远快于他国。这些日益扩大的不对称性加剧了战略依赖，并带来经济与安全方面的深远影响。

title: DP44 Economic Implications of Demographic Change
title_zh: 人口变化的经济影响
title_primary: 人口变化的经济影响
title_secondary: DP44 Economic Implications of Demographic Change
authors: John F Ermisch, Alison Booth, Jeff Frank, Marco Francesconi, Dennis Snower 等
official: 聚合元数据日期 2016-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper shows how previous fluctuations in births affect the educational system, relative earnings and unemployment rates in the labour market, the number and composition of households, patterns of housing consumption, pressures in health services and personal social services, and finally contribution rates in the state retirement pension system. It also shows how members of large generations may suffer in educational opportunities, in their lifetime earnings prospects and possibly in the pensions that they receive.
abstract_zh: 本文展示了出生人数的历史波动如何影响教育体系、劳动力市场中的相对收入与失业率、家庭数量与构成、住房消费模式、医疗服务及个人社会服务的压力，以及国家退休养老金体系的缴费率。同时，本文揭示了大规模世代成员可能在教育机会、终身收入前景乃至所获养老金方面遭受的不利影响。

title: Land decentralization and grain production: Evidence from Chinese counties
title_zh: 土地分权与粮食生产：来自中国县级数据的证据
title_primary: 土地分权与粮食生产：来自中国县级数据的证据
title_secondary: Land decentralization and grain production: Evidence from Chinese counties
authors: Hongqi Ma, Weiyi Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land decentralization is a major component of China’s land governance reforms, but its implications for food security remain unclear. Using panel data from 1659 Chinese counties from 2003 to 2018, this study applies a difference-in-differences (DID) approach to examine its effect on grain production. The results show that land decentralization significantly reduces county-level grain output, with stronger effects in urban agglomerations and major grain-producing regions. Mechanism analysis shows that land decentralization expands construction land, reduces cultivated land, and limits the scale of grain cultivation. It also worsens cultivated land production conditions and lowers grain yield per unit area, especially in areas with more rugged terrain. These findings suggest that, under the cultivated land requisition-compensation balance system, some areas may replace high-quality farmland with lower-quality land, which can reduce cultivated land productivity. The study reveals a potential conflict between local development autonomy and food security in the context of rapid urbanization. It also provides empirical evidence for sustainable land management policies.
abstract_zh: 土地 decentralization 是中国土地治理改革的重要组成部分，但其对粮食安全的影响尚不明确。本研究利用2003年至2018年中国1659个县的面板数据，采用双重差分法（DID）考察其对粮食生产的影响。结果表明，土地 decentralization 显著降低了县级粮食产量，且在 urban agglomerations 和主要粮食产区的影响更为显著。机制分析显示，土地 decentralization 扩大了建设用地，减少了耕地面积，并限制了粮食种植规模。同时，它还恶化了耕地生产条件，降低了单位面积粮食产量，尤其是在地形较为崎岖的地区。这些发现表明，在耕地占补平衡制度下，一些地区可能用质量较低的土地替代优质农田，从而降低耕地生产力。本研究揭示了快速城市化背景下地方发展自主权与粮食安全之间的潜在冲突，并为可持续土地管理政策提供了实证依据。

title: Long-Term Securities and Banking Crises
title_zh: 长期证券与银行危机
title_primary: 长期证券与银行危机
title_secondary: Long-Term Securities and Banking Crises
authors: Miao, Jianjun, Shen, Zhouxiang, Su, Dongling
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We incorporate banks into a DSGE framework to study how interest rate hikes affect the macroeconomy. The procyclical bank balance sheets and long-term bond prices amplify adverse shocks, which can trigger a bank run. We introduce a macroprudential policy that can mitigate or prevent banking crises: an ex-ante permanent tax on bank holdings of long-term government bonds and reducing the tax rate in response to interest rate hikes. By contrast, subsidizing bank holdings of long-term investment bonds improves welfare when capital producers face loan-in-advance constraints.
abstract_zh: 我们将银行纳入DSGE框架，研究加息如何影响宏观经济。顺周期的银行资产负债表和长期债券价格会放大负面冲击，从而可能引发银行挤兑。我们引入一项宏观审慎政策，该政策能够缓解或预防银行业危机：对银行持有的长期政府债券征收事前永久性税收，并在加息时降低税率。相比之下，当资本生产者面临贷款预付约束时，补贴银行持有的长期投资债券能够提升社会福利。

title: Born in Smog: Immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
title_zh: 雾霾中诞生：1892-1919年伦敦历史急性空气污染暴露的即时与持续健康后果
title_primary: 雾霾中诞生：1892-1919年伦敦历史急性空气污染暴露的即时与持续健康后果
title_secondary: Born in Smog: Immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
authors: Eric B. Schneider
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾天事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理变量——这些雾天反映了城市排放的污染物因无法扩散而导致污染浓度急剧飙升的气象条件。同时，我采用来自夏洛特女王医院（一家妇产医院）和弃婴医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结局、生长发育指标或上呼吸道疾病发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的污染暴露对健康产生了持续性影响：它增加了儿童期及青少年期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感与麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内暴露和产后暴露则未发现持续性影响。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染暴露对儿童健康的特定维度（但范围有限）产生了持久影响。

title: Industrial internet and green total factor productivity: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China’s renewable energy industry
title_zh: 工业互联网与绿色全要素生产率：来自中国可再生能源行业准自然实验的证据
title_primary: 工业互联网与绿色全要素生产率：来自中国可再生能源行业准自然实验的证据
title_secondary: Industrial internet and green total factor productivity: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China’s renewable energy industry
authors: Yi Xiao, Longjia Fu, Yuxin Xu, Xiongtian Shi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study aims to investigate whether and how industrial internet platform (IIP) adoption translates digital connectivity into measurable green productivity gains at the firm level. Utilizing a comprehensive sample of listed companies in China’s renewable energy sector spanning from 2008 to 2024, we specify a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to empirically test the relationship between IIP access and corporate green total factor productivity (GTFP). Our findings demonstrate that IIP adoption significantly enhances GTFP, remaining robust across multiple sensitivity tests. Mechanism analyses reveal that this enhancement is driven primarily by data network effects and digital-first innovation strategies. Furthermore, cross-sectional analyses indicate that the positive impact is more pronounced in firms characterized by lower labour intensity, higher market competition, and lower asset specificity. Based on these findings, we suggest that management should strategically integrate IIP into their internal operations. IIP providers should develop and embed real-time carbon monitoring tools to lower technical barriers for adoption. Policymakers should shift from generic subsidies to targeted interventions, offering specific fiscal incentives to alleviate the high transition costs faced by firms with rigid asset structures.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究工业互联网平台（IIP）的采用是否以及如何将数字互联转化为企业层面可测度的绿色生产力提升。基于2008至2024年中国可再生能源行业上市公司的综合样本，我们构建了交错双重差分（DID）模型，实证检验IIP接入与企业绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）之间的关系。研究结果表明，IIP采用显著提升了GTFP，该结论在多项敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析揭示，这一提升主要源于数据网络效应与数字优先创新战略。进一步异质性分析显示，在劳动密集度较低、市场竞争程度较高及资产专用性较低的企业中，IIP的积极影响更为显著。基于上述发现，我们建议管理层应将IIP战略性地融入内部运营；IIP提供商应开发并嵌入实时碳监测工具以降低采用技术门槛；政策制定者应从普惠式补贴转向精准干预，通过提供针对性财政激励措施，缓解资产结构僵化企业面临的高额转型成本。

title: The Impact of Immigration on Social Trust of Natives: Evidence from the Mass Migration in China
title_zh: 移民对本地居民社会信任的影响：来自中国大规模人口迁移的证据
title_primary: 移民对本地居民社会信任的影响：来自中国大规模人口迁移的证据
title_secondary: The Impact of Immigration on Social Trust of Natives: Evidence from the Mass Migration in China
authors: Shu Cai, Lingwei Wu, Xiong Xiao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the impact of immigration on natives' social trust in the context of China's mass internal migration. Combining individual-level information on social trust and county-level information on immigration rate, we employ the instrumental variable strategy and find that immigration has a significant negative impact on trust among native residents. The impact of immigration on trust is more salient for trust in weak ties than trust in strong ties, and from a compositional perspective, the impact of low-skilled immigrants is more salient than that of high-skilled immigrants. Additional analyses suggest that better public services can buffer the impact of immigration on trust, implying a key role in public policy.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国大规模内部人口迁移为背景，考察移民对本地居民社会信任的影响。通过结合个体层面的社会信任数据与县级层面的移民率信息，采用工具变量策略发现：移民对本地居民的社会信任具有显著的负向影响。从信任类型来看，移民对弱关系信任的冲击强于强关系信任；从移民结构来看，低技能移民的影响比高技能移民更为显著。进一步分析表明，更优质的公共服务能够缓冲移民对信任的冲击，这揭示了公共政策在此过程中的关键作用。

title: DP21708 Causal inference for social network formation
title_zh: 社交网络形成的因果推断
title_primary: 社交网络形成的因果推断
title_secondary: DP21708 Causal inference for social network formation
authors: Maximilian Kasy, Elizabeth Linos, Sanaz Mobasseri
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a framework for identification, estimation, and inference on the causal mechanisms driving endogenous social network formation. Identification is challenging because of unobserved confounders and reverse causality; inference is complicated by questions of equilibrium and sampling. We leverage repeated observations of a network over time and random variation in initial ties to address challenges to causal identification. Our design-based approach sidesteps questions of sampling and asymptotics by treating both the set of nodes (individuals) and potential outcomes as non-random. We apply our approach to data from a large professional services firm, where new hires are randomly assigned to project teams within offices. We estimate the causal effect on tie formation of indirect ties, network degree, and local network density. Indirect ties have a strong and significant positive effect on tie formation, while the effects of degree and density are smaller and less robust.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个用于识别、估计和推断内生社交网络形成因果机制的分析框架。由于存在未观测到的混杂因素和反向因果关系，识别过程面临挑战；而均衡与抽样问题则使推断变得复杂。我们利用网络随时间推移的重复观测数据以及初始联系的随机变异，以应对因果识别中的挑战。这种基于设计的方法将节点（个体）集合与潜在结果均视为非随机变量，从而规避了抽样与渐近性问题。我们将该方法应用于一家大型专业服务公司的数据——该公司新员工被随机分配到办公室内的项目团队中。我们估算了间接联系、网络度数及局部网络密度对联系形成的因果效应。结果表明，间接联系对联系形成具有显著且稳健的正向影响，而网络度数与密度的效应则相对较小且不够稳健。

title: Prosocial cultural heritage and corporate philanthropy
title_zh: 亲社会文化遗产与企业慈善行为
title_primary: 亲社会文化遗产与企业慈善行为
title_secondary: Prosocial cultural heritage and corporate philanthropy
authors: Li Huang, Oliver Zhen Li, Shan Wang, Lijun Xia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: China's Communist revolution in the early 20th century left a prosocial cultural heritage in its historical revolutionary bases, consistent with the framework of group-level selection in cultural evolution. We document a robust positive association between local communist revolutionary heritage and corporate donations. This prosocial inclination is distinct from other historical influences, such as Confucian traditions or histories of peasant revolts, though it attenuates with local marketization. We employ propensity score matching, a neighboring-county test, a boundary-based spatial comparison, and an instrumental variable analysis to buttress a causal inference from the prosocial revolutionary heritage to corporate donations. Stakeholder demand and manager intrinsic preference emerge as parallel, mutually reinforcing channels underlining this relationship. Further analyses rule out alternative explanations, such as “grabbing hand” behavior, strategic motives, or political incentives. Collectively, these findings reveal a cultural imprint of Communist revolution history on corporate prosociality in contemporary China.
abstract_zh: 20世纪初的中国共产主义革命在其历史革命根据地留下了亲社会文化遗产，这与文化进化中的群体选择框架相吻合。我们记录了地方共产主义革命遗产与企业捐赠之间稳健的正相关关系。这种亲社会倾向不同于其他历史影响，如儒家传统或农民起义历史，尽管它随地方市场化程度而减弱。我们采用倾向得分匹配、邻近县检验、基于边界的空间比较以及工具变量分析，以支持从亲社会革命遗产到企业捐赠的因果推断。利益相关者需求与管理者内在偏好作为平行且相互强化的渠道，凸显了这一关系。进一步分析排除了“掠夺之手”行为、战略动机或政治激励等替代解释。总体而言，这些发现揭示了共产主义革命历史对当代中国企业亲社会行为的文化印记。

title: A better ride: New evidence on travel and the quality of roads in England and Wales, 1660-1820
title_zh: 更好的出行：英格兰与威尔士道路质量与旅行关系的新证据（1660-1820）
title_primary: 更好的出行：英格兰与威尔士道路质量与旅行关系的新证据（1660-1820）
title_secondary: A better ride: New evidence on travel and the quality of roads in England and Wales, 1660-1820
authors: Dan Bogart, Alan Rosevear, Leigh Shaw-Taylor
official: 来源期次 2026-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Travel improved dramatically between 1660 and 1820 in England and Wales. This paper uses nearly 100 travellers’ diaries to study the mode choice, speed of road transport and the quality of the roads used from the mid-1600s to 1820. Using mapping software, we digitise journeys made by various travel modes along more than 348,000 journey miles. We document that travel shifted from the saddlehorse to wheeled vehicles and that speed increased, although to a lesser degree in private or hired carriages compared to stagecoaches. We also report a novel measure of road quality using diarists’ descriptions of the road. The reported quality of many main roads went from ‘poor’ to ‘adequate’ or ‘good’ by the early 19th century. We also show that turnpike trusts, a novel organization for road funding, contributed to significantly better quality and were favoured over other roads by travellers in wheeled vehicles. Our estimates imply that the spread of turnpike trusts can account for most of the road quality change from 1660 to 1820.
abstract_zh: 1660年至1820年间，英格兰和威尔士的旅行条件显著改善。本文利用近100位旅行者的日记，研究了从17世纪中期至1820年间出行方式的选择、道路运输速度及所用道路的质量。借助地图绘制软件，我们将各种出行方式超过348,000英里的旅程进行了数字化处理。研究发现，出行方式从骑马转向了轮式车辆，且速度有所提升，尽管私人或租赁马车的速度提升幅度不及公共马车。我们还通过日记作者对道路的描述，提出了一种新颖的道路质量衡量指标。至19世纪初，许多主要道路的报告质量从“差”提升至“尚可”或“良好”。此外，我们表明，作为道路融资的新型组织，收费信托机构显著改善了道路质量，并受到轮式车辆旅行者的青睐。我们的估算显示，收费信托机构的普及可以解释1660年至1820年间大部分道路质量的改善。

title: The rise of China in academic research
title_zh: 中国学术研究的崛起
title_primary: 中国学术研究的崛起
title_secondary: The rise of China in academic research
authors: Laeven, Luc, Popov, Alexander, Cozariuc, Catalina
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Analyzing more than 300,000 articles across 40 top-tier journals between 2000 and 2022, this study demonstrates that China’s 2006 National Medium-and Long-Term Plan for the Development of Science and Technology catalyzed a surge in publication volume and citations, propelling China past the United States as the world’s leading producer of scientific research. Controlling for national income, population, and human capital, we find these gains are concentrated in fields explicitly targeted by the government’s plan—physics, chemistry, biology, and medicine—while fields excluded from the plan, such as mathematics and economics, show significantly less growth. Our findings suggest that targeted state-led investment can effectively drive scientific progress, at least within a centrally planned economy. JEL Classification: F63, H52, I28, O38, P27
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2000年至2022年间40种顶级期刊上的超过30万篇文章，表明中国2006年《国家中长期科学和技术发展规划纲要》催化了论文发表量和引用量的激增，推动中国超越美国成为全球领先的科学研究产出国家。在控制国民收入、人口和人力资本因素后，我们发现这些增长集中在政府计划明确针对的领域——物理学、化学、生物学和医学——而计划未涵盖的领域，如数学和经济学，增长则显著较少。我们的研究结果表明，至少在中央计划经济体制内，有针对性的国家主导投资能够有效推动科学进步。JEL分类号：F63, H52, I28, O38, P27

title: DP21638 The Economic Costs of Religious Riots in India
title_zh: 印度宗教骚乱的经济成本
title_primary: 印度宗教骚乱的经济成本
title_secondary: DP21638 The Economic Costs of Religious Riots in India
authors: Sriya Iyer, Dmitrii Petrukhin, Anand Shrivastava
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district–year panel for 1994–2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45\%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，结合扩展的骚乱数据、夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷数据，估算了社区骚乱的经济影响。为处理内生性问题，我们利用印度教主要节日恰逢周五（周五大量穆斯林聚集进行每周祈祷）时产生的准随机变异，构建了本地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，骚乱暴露程度越高，经济损失越大且具有持续性。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出和就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷下降以及市场基础设施薄弱。利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。

title: How does sovereign credit rating affect foreign direct investment? Evidence from Belt and Road economies
title_zh: 主权信用评级如何影响外国直接投资？来自“一带一路”经济体的证据
title_primary: 主权信用评级如何影响外国直接投资？来自“一带一路”经济体的证据
title_secondary: How does sovereign credit rating affect foreign direct investment? Evidence from Belt and Road economies
authors: Liang Ma, Xuecheng Huang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article examines foreign direct investment (FDI) flows from global investor economies to Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) recipient economies during 2010–2021 against the backdrop of rising global uncertainty, with a particular focus on the role of sovereign credit ratings as financial information intermediaries. The results show that upgrades in both investor-economy and recipient-economy sovereign credit ratings are significantly associated with higher bilateral FDI flows into BRI economies. The heterogeneity analysis reveals that the positive effect of recipient-economy rating improvements on FDI inflows is more pronounced when the investor economy is a BRI economy, a developing economy, or a global tax haven. In contrast, the promoting effect of investor-economy rating improvements on FDI outflows is more evident when the investor economy is a non-BRI economy, a developed economy, or a non-tax-haven economy. Mechanism results provide suggestive evidence that rating upgrades in recipient economies may strengthen FDI ‘pull’ effects by signalling improvements in the investment environment, whereas rating improvements in investor economies may support FDI ‘push’ effects by reflecting stronger outward investment capacity. Overall, the findings underscore the critical role of sovereign credit ratings as financial information intermediaries in cross-border capital allocation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2010—2021年间，在全球不确定性上升的背景下，全球投资者经济体对“一带一路”倡议（BRI）受援经济体的外国直接投资（FDI）流动情况，特别关注主权信用评级作为金融信息中介的作用。研究结果表明，投资者经济体与受援经济体的主权信用评级上调均与流入BRI经济体的双边FDI显著增加相关。异质性分析显示，当投资者经济体为BRI经济体、发展中经济体或全球避税天堂时，受援经济体评级改善对FDI流入的正向效应更为显著。相反，当投资者经济体为非BRI经济体、发达经济体或非避税天堂经济体时，投资者经济体评级改善对FDI流出的促进作用更为明显。机制结果提供了提示性证据，表明受援经济体评级上调可能通过传递投资环境改善的信号来强化FDI的“拉力”效应，而投资者经济体评级改善则可能通过反映更强的对外投资能力来支持FDI的“推力”效应。总体而言，研究结果强调了主权信用评级作为金融信息中介在跨境资本配置中的关键作用。

title: Disentangling risk and time for optimal prevention
title_zh: 分离风险与时间以实现最优预防
title_primary: 分离风险与时间以实现最优预防
title_secondary: Disentangling risk and time for optimal prevention
authors: Yichun Chi, Richard Peter, Mengjia Qi
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the effect of prudence on optimal prevention in two periods with Kreps and Porteus (1978) and Selden (1978) (KPS) preferences. We use consumption smoothing as the benchmark and consider risk-averse decision-makers. In this framework, prudence has a positive effect on prevention, generalizing findings of Menegatti (2009). We extend this result to risk lovers and comparative risk aversion. When saving is endogenized, the preference over the timing of uncertainty resolution becomes irrelevant for prevention, and only the curvature of marginal utility matters. This result allows us to identify a class of decision-makers who are prudent in the KPS model but whose prevention effort coincides with that of a risk-neutral agent. Our findings highlight that the structure of intertemporal preferences critically shapes the link between prudence and prevention.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在Kreps与Porteus（1978）及Selden（1978）（KPS）偏好框架下，审慎性对两期最优预防行为的影响。以消费平滑为基准，我们考察风险厌恶型决策者。在此框架中，审慎性对预防行为具有正向促进作用，从而推广了Menegatti（2009）的研究结论。我们将该结论拓展至风险偏好型决策者及比较风险厌恶情形。当储蓄内生化时，不确定性解决的时间偏好对预防行为不再具有影响，仅边际效用曲率发挥作用。这一发现使我们能够识别出KPS模型中具有审慎性、但其预防努力水平与风险中性主体一致的决策者群体。研究结果凸显跨期偏好结构对审慎性与预防行为关联性的关键塑造作用。

title: When pandemics meet climate risk: An agent-based model of non-linear macroeconomic dynamics under compound stress
title_zh: 当流行病遇上气候风险：复合压力下非线性宏观经济动态的基于主体模型
title_primary: 当流行病遇上气候风险：复合压力下非线性宏观经济动态的基于主体模型
title_secondary: When pandemics meet climate risk: An agent-based model of non-linear macroeconomic dynamics under compound stress
authors: Paola D’Orazio, Anh-Duy Pham, Son Hong Nguyen
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how pandemic and physical climate risks can co-evolve endogenously and jointly shape macroeconomic, financial, and environmental outcomes. It introduces CliMaPan Lab, an agent-based framework that incorporates epidemiological dynamics and a channel linking emissions, atmospheric concentrations, and temperature within a macroeconomic-financial environment featuring heterogeneous households and firms, as well as adaptive behavior. The framework is designed to capture non-linear propagation and state dependence under alternative public-health interventions. Simulation results show that stronger contact suppression is associated with faster infection control, but also with larger contemporaneous contractions in GDP and consumption, alongside weaker credit activity. Vaccination-centered regimes, and to a lesser extent social distancing, are associated with fewer severe outcomes and comparatively smoother macroeconomic and credit trajectories when protection accumulates sufficiently early. When physical climate risk is activated, cumulative damages weaken economic performance and increase persistence, with larger disruptions under compound scenarios where pandemic-related labor-market frictions interact with climate-related production losses. Emissions decline during pandemic disruptions but rebound as activity normalizes. Under compound risk, more persistent emissions reductions primarily reflect prolonged economic weakness rather than an endogenous decarbonization transition. Overall, the findings indicate that compound risks can generate non-additive, path-dependent dynamics that are not captured by single-risk analyses.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了疫情风险与物理气候风险如何内生地共同演化，并联合影响宏观经济、金融及环境结果。研究引入了CliMaPan Lab框架，这是一个基于主体的模型体系，整合了流行病学动态以及排放、大气浓度与温度之间的关联渠道，置于包含异质性家庭与企业及适应性行为的宏观经济-金融环境中。该框架旨在捕捉不同公共卫生干预措施下的非线性传导与状态依赖性。模拟结果显示，更强的接触抑制措施虽能加速感染控制，但同时也伴随当期GDP与消费的更大收缩，以及信贷活动的减弱。以疫苗接种为核心的机制，以及程度较轻的社交距离措施，在保护措施足够早积累的情况下，与较少的严重结果及相对更平稳的宏观经济和信贷轨迹相关联。当物理气候风险被激活时，累积损害削弱经济表现并增强持续性，在疫情相关劳动力市场摩擦与气候相关生产损失相互作用的复合情景下，干扰更为显著。疫情期间排放量下降，但随着经济活动正常化而反弹。在复合风险下，更持久的排放减少主要反映的是长期经济疲软，而非内生脱碳转型。总体而言，研究结果表明，复合风险能产生非加总、路径依赖的动态效应，这些效应是单一风险分析无法捕捉的。

title: Cash versus contactless mobile payment: The effect of payment modes on donation behaviors
title_zh: 现金与非接触式移动支付：支付方式对捐赠行为的影响

title_secondary: Cash versus contactless mobile payment: The effect of payment modes on donation behaviors
authors: Jingping Li, Fang Liu, Yohanes E. Riyanto
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examined the effect of different payment methods on charitable donations through a lab experiment. Participants participated in a real donation scenario where they could choose between cash or contactless mobile payments. The results indicate that contactless mobile payment led to higher donation amounts compared to cash. We suggest that the greater familiarity with the payment mode plays a significant role in increasing donation, particularly as the widespread use of contactless payments during pandemic lockdowns likely made people more comfortable with mobile payments, resulting in more generous donations.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验室实验考察了不同支付方式对慈善捐赠的影响。参与者在真实捐赠情境中可选择现金或非接触式移动支付。结果显示，相较于现金，非接触式移动支付带来了更高的捐赠金额。我们认为，对支付方式的更高熟悉度在促进捐赠中扮演重要角色，尤其是在疫情期间封锁期间非接触支付的广泛使用，可能使人们更习惯于移动支付，从而表现出更慷慨的捐赠行为。

title: The illusion of free electricity: Household responses to solar panel program in Singapore
title_zh: 免费电力的幻觉：新加坡家庭对太阳能板项目的反应
title_primary: 免费电力的幻觉：新加坡家庭对太阳能板项目的反应
title_secondary: The illusion of free electricity: Household responses to solar panel program in Singapore
authors: Jinze Cao, Mingxuan Fan
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of solar panel program announcements on household utility consumption. Using anonymized monthly block level electricity and water consumption data for each flat type from January 2011 to December 2020 in Singapore and a staggered difference-in-differences approach, we find that public housing buildings affected by the solar panel program tender announcements experience a 2.1% increase in monthly electricity consumption and a 2.3% increase in water consumption. We attribute this pattern to a financial misperception whereby households mistakenly believe that collective solar adoption will reduce their electricity costs, after ruling out alternative explanations such as changes in energy prices, wealth effects, and moral licensing. Our findings highlight the importance of effective information dissemination for the successful implementation of solar energy initiatives.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了太阳能板项目公告对家庭公用事业消费的影响。利用2011年1月至2020年12月新加坡各户型每月匿名区块级电力与用水数据，并采用交错双重差分法，我们发现受太阳能板项目招标公告影响的公共住房建筑，其月度电力消费增加了2.1%，用水消费增加了2.3%。我们将这一现象归因于一种财务误解，即家庭错误地认为集体采用太阳能将降低其电费支出，在排除了能源价格变动、财富效应及道德许可等替代解释后，这一结论依然成立。我们的研究结果强调了有效信息传播对于太阳能倡议成功实施的重要性。

title: What Happens When Dating Goes Online? Evidence from U.S. Marriage Markets and Health Outcomes
title_zh: 当约会转向线上：来自美国婚姻市场与健康结果的证据
title_primary: 当约会转向线上：来自美国婚姻市场与健康结果的证据
title_secondary: What Happens When Dating Goes Online? Evidence from U.S. Marriage Markets and Health Outcomes
authors: Advisory Board, Daniel Ershov, Jessica Fong, Pinar Yildirim, Pablo Casas-Arce 等
official: 官方在线 2026-01-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how online dating platforms have impacted marital outcomes, assortative matching, and sexually transmitted disease (STD) rates in the United States. We construct county-level measures of online dating usage using data from website-based platforms (2002–2013) and mobile app-based platforms (2017–2023). Leveraging county-level variation and an instrumental variable strategy, we show in the desktop era, a 1% increase in online dating sessions raises divorce rates by 0.50%, while in the mobile era, a 1% increase in online dating activity lowers marriage and divorce rates by 0.40% and 0.33%, respectively. We also document shifts in assortative matching. Desktop sites reduce sorting along education and employment dimensions, whereas mobile sites reduce sorting by employment, but increase sorting by race. Across both eras, we find no evidence that greater online dating usage increases average STD rates. Average effects are negative or statistically insignificant, but are positive for some subpopulations. We develop a search and matching model where technological changes impact search costs, market size, and market noise can explain our empirical findings.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在线约会平台如何影响美国的婚姻结果、分类匹配以及性传播疾病（STD）发病率。我们利用基于网站的平台（2002-2013年）和基于移动应用的平台（2017-2023年）的数据，构建了县级层面的在线约会使用率指标。借助县级层面的差异和工具变量策略，我们发现在桌面互联网时代，在线约会次数每增加1%，离婚率上升0.50%；而在移动互联网时代，在线约会活动每增加1%，结婚率和离婚率分别下降0.40%和0.33%。我们还记录了分类匹配的变化：桌面网站降低了基于教育和就业维度的分类匹配，而移动网站则降低了基于就业的分类匹配，但增加了基于种族的分类匹配。在两个时代中，我们均未发现在线约会使用率提高会显著增加平均STD发病率的证据。平均效应为负或统计上不显著，但对某些子群体而言呈正效应。我们构建了一个搜索与匹配模型，其中技术变革影响搜索成本、市场规模和市场噪音，该模型能够解释我们的实证发现。

title: Left in Charge: Political Rule and the Rise of Local Welfare
title_zh: 留守掌权：政治统治与地方福利的兴起
title_primary: 留守掌权：政治统治与地方福利的兴起
title_secondary: Left in Charge: Political Rule and the Rise of Local Welfare
authors: Casper Worm Hansen, Peter Sandholdt Jensen
official: 官方在线 2026-01-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how institutional constraints on executive selection shape redistributive policy, using a 1919 Danish reform that allowed town councils to democratically elect mayors. While the reform applied uniformly across towns, it made left-wing executive control politically feasible for the first time, particularly in towns with stronger prior support for the Social Democratic party. Exploiting predetermined Social Democratic vote shares from the 1917 election interacted with the post-reform period, we identify the causal effect of Social Democratic executive control on local public finance. We show that Social Democratic mayors substantially increased social spending, especially on poor relief and public assistance, with these expansions financed primarily through higher direct taxes. We find no robust evidence that these policies reduced local economic activity. The results highlight how removing institutional constraints on executive selection can translate latent voter preferences into concrete redistributive policy outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1919年丹麦的一项改革（该改革允许市镇委员会民主选举市长）来研究行政长官选拔的制度约束如何影响再分配政策。尽管改革统一适用于所有市镇，但它首次使左翼行政长官控制权在政治上成为可能，尤其是在那些先前对社会民主党支持度较高的市镇。通过利用1917年选举中既定的社会民主党得票率与改革后时期的交互作用，我们识别出社会民主党行政长官控制权对地方公共财政的因果效应。研究表明，社会民主党市长显著增加了社会支出，尤其是贫困救济和公共援助，这些扩张主要通过提高直接税来融资。我们没有发现这些政策抑制地方经济活动的稳健证据。研究结果凸显了消除行政长官选拔的制度约束如何将潜在的选民偏好转化为具体的再分配政策结果。

title: Spanish stock returns, growth, and inflation, 1900–2020
title_zh: 西班牙股票回报、增长与通胀，1900–2020
title_primary: 西班牙股票回报、增长与通胀，1900–2020
title_secondary: Spanish stock returns, growth, and inflation, 1900–2020
authors: Stefano Battilossi, Stefan O. Houpt, Miguel Artola Blanco
official: 官方在线 2025-10-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies equity returns in the Madrid Stock Exchange and their connections with the macroeconomy from the emergence of a stock market around 1900 to its ‘big bang’ at the turn of the twenty‐first century. Using high‐quality data from primary sources and the methodology of the modern IBEX35 (published since 1987), we constructed an original index, the historical IBEX (H‐IBEX), for the period 1900–87. With 120 years of monthly data, we empirically test the ability of stock prices to predict real economic activity, provide a detailed chronology of market cycles, and analyse their time‐varying characteristics across stages of market development and macroeconomic regimes. We also assess the role of Spanish equities as an inflation hedge and compare their long‐run investment performance in an international perspective. Our data confirm that the Civil War (1936–9) had only a moderately negative impact on equity wealth compared with other economic disasters of the twentieth century. In the long run, Spanish equities underperformed most European markets due to a massive destruction of financial wealth in the stagflation of the 1970s–80s and the transition to an open economy after decades of protectionism. This was the true ‘rare disaster’ suffered by Spanish investors in the twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了马德里股票市场的股权回报及其与宏观经济之间的联系，时间跨度从约1900年股市初现至二十一世纪初的“大爆炸”变革。利用来自原始资料的高质量数据及现代IBEX35指数（自1987年发布）的方法论，我们构建了一个原创指数——历史IBEX（H-IBEX），覆盖1900年至1987年期间。凭借120年的月度数据，我们实证检验了股价预测实际经济活动的能力，提供了市场周期的详细年表，并分析了这些周期在不同市场发展阶段和宏观经济体制下的时变特征。我们还评估了西班牙股票作为通胀对冲工具的作用，并从国际视角比较了其长期投资表现。我们的数据证实，与二十世纪其他经济灾难相比，内战（1936-1939年）对股权财富的影响仅为中度负面。长期来看，由于1970至1980年代滞胀期间金融财富的大规模毁灭，以及数十年保护主义后向开放经济的转型，西班牙股票表现逊于大多数欧洲市场。这是二十世纪西班牙投资者所遭受的真正“罕见灾难”。

title: The dynamic optimization problem of enterprise’s production from the perspective of green development
title_zh: 绿色发展视角下企业生产的动态优化问题
title_primary: 绿色发展视角下企业生产的动态优化问题
title_secondary: The dynamic optimization problem of enterprise’s production from the perspective of green development
authors: Pan Chen School of Economics, Shandong University, Jinan, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article is concerned with a green production optimization problem of enterprises and obtains the optimal production strategy. A stochastic green production model is established by introducing stochastic differential equations. The carbon quota is incorporated as a control variable. We transform the problem to one kind of optimal control problems. In virtue of the convex variational technique and Ekeland variational principle, the maximum principle is established. Finally, we use this result to solve the original enterprise’s production optimization problem in the specified context. Our model and our results can have many policy implications. They can also be used by governments to price externalities and side effects, as the principle is to tax companies that issue more carbon and pollution.
abstract_zh: 本文关注企业的绿色生产优化问题，并获得了最优生产策略。通过引入随机微分方程，建立了一个随机绿色生产模型。将碳配额作为控制变量纳入考量。我们将该问题转化为一类最优控制问题。借助凸变分技术和Ekeland变分原理，建立了最大值原理。最后，我们利用这一结果在特定情境下解决了企业原始的生产优化问题。我们的模型和结果具有多项政策启示，也可供政府用于对外部性和副作用定价，其原则是对排放更多碳和污染的企业征税。
